title: coniogramme japonica
intro: Coniogramme japonica, commonly known as Japanese nettle, is a plant species in the family Compositae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of arthritis. The therapeutic actions of Japanese nettle include its ability to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and compounds, making it a potential natural remedy for various inflammatory conditions. Bioactive constituents of Japanese nettle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
